says: In next/, the settings command's L7 law never has a successful run whose report shows the person's file as an origin, so the shown name of the person's file in node/settings/Command.ts (line 62) is held by no law.
proof: In a scratch worktree of e46fae8f7, Command.ts line 62 was changed to name the person's file ~/.kalfa/kalfa.toml while still reading the right path. nice -n 15 pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 next/packages/libfabrika/src/node/settings/Command.test.ts printed 3 passed, also with FABRIKA_TEST_DEPTH=full. A log of L7's 100 cases showed 0 successful runs whose report contains 'line', since every valid person port came with a flag that overrode it. Command.test.ts is not changed by this branch, so main has the same gap.
cost: A change that shows the wrong file name to a person running fabrika settings passes every law.
